title: 剪纸层叠
description: 一层一色的剪影，靠阴影分成远近。一支 20 秒短片，同一座六层风景贯穿全片：先自己叠好，再被放进海报编辑器、收进天气 App、被镜头穿过，然后用自己演示五条规则和三个常见坑。层移即故事。

images.titleEn: Five rules, palette, parallax, and do / don’t

images.title: 如果剪纸层叠来做 App
一张平涂，四步改成剪纸层叠
images.titleEn: Four steps from a flat fill to Paper Cut

descriptionEn: Layered paper silhouettes, one flat color per sheet, depth made only by the shadow in the gap. A 20-second film in which the same six-layer landscape stacks itself, becomes a poster on an editor artboard, a weather-app illustration with scroll parallax, and a brand title flying through paper strata, then demonstrates five rules and three pitfalls.
